C75.content_en:
Ways to find sites that use a given technology — and how the main tools compare

A sales rep wants to collect sites that use a technology such as Shopify as prospects. Enter a technology name and this tool tabulates ten Japanese sites using it, with domain, country and title.

Method / toolPricing modelNotes
This tool (DataForSEO)Pay per request. About $0.024 per 10 rows (measured), roughly 41 calls per $1Ten Japanese sites using the technology, plus the number of matching sites, in tables. Save as CSV
Wappalyzer (lead lists)A free account gets sample lists; lead lists need a paid plan (official pricing page)A service that builds lists of sites by technology
BuiltWith (lead lists)Exporting lists needs a paid plan (official page)A service that builds lists of sites by technology
Search on Google (by hand)FreeLook for phrases such as "Powered by ○○"; prone to misses

Checked in November 2026. Prices change — confirm on each vendor's official site before you buy.

Why use this tool

  • Narrowed to Japanese sites. Japanese sites using Shopify numbered 6,788 (measured).
  • Ten prospects in one call. It returned in about 5 to 7 seconds (measured).
  • About $0.024 per call. That is for 10 rows, roughly 41 calls per $1.
  • Pick the technology name from suggestions. Typing "shopify" in lowercase is corrected to "Shopify".
  • Save as CSV. A draft for your sales list.

When it is not the right fit

  • You want more than 10 → this tool stops at 10 to keep the price down.
  • You want contact details → the table has only domain, country and title.
  • You want to choose which 10 → the 10 are in the order DataForSEO returns.
  • The name is not on the list → a name that is not in the list is rejected before any charge.

This tool does one thing: show ten Japanese sites that use a technology, and how many match in total.

FAQ

Why only Japanese sites?

The tool is meant for finding prospects in Japan, so the country is fixed to Japan. This filter is a rule of this tool.

Why only 10 rows?

To keep the price down. 10 rows cost about $0.024.

Where do I look up technology names?

Start typing in the box and suggestions appear, taken from DataForSEO's free list of technology names.

Does it matter whether I use capitals?

DataForSEO is case-sensitive: lowercase returned 0 rows and was still charged (measured). This tool fixes the spelling from the list before sending.

Can I sign up with a free email address?

No. DataForSEO does not accept free email providers. See What is DataForSEO?

C76.content_en:
Ways to check a domain's registration and expiry dates — and how the main tools compare

In web production you want to confirm when a client's domain was registered and how long it is valid. Enter a domain and this tool tabulates the registration date, changed date, expiry date and registrar.

* You can now enter many items, one per line (each is sent one by one, so you pay per item). The table gets an "Input" column. Where the text below says "one", it describes a single item. See the table at the top for the cost.

Method / toolPricing modelNotes
This tool (DataForSEO)Pay per request. About $0.1212 per call (measured), roughly 8 per $1One domain's registration date, changed date, expiry date and registrar in a table. Save as CSV
ICANN LookupFreeICANN's official page for looking up domain registration data
IANA WHOISSee the official siteIANA's page for looking up top-level domains such as .com (see the official site for features)
Your registrar's dashboardDepends on your contractShows the expiry of your own domains; not other people's

Checked in November 2026. Prices change — confirm on each vendor's official site before you buy.

Why use this tool

  • Registration and expiry dates in one row. shopify.com showed registration on 2005-03-11, changed on 2025-03-19 and expiry on 2027-03-11 (measured).
  • The registrar too. shopify.com was registered through MarkMonitor Inc. (measured).
  • Paste a URL if you like. It is converted to the domain before the lookup.
  • A few seconds. We measured under 1 second for shopify.com and 3 to 4 seconds in Japan.
  • Save as CSV. Keep a record of a domain's age.

When it is not the right fit

  • The price per call is high → about $0.1212 per call. If you only check one at a time, a free page such as ICANN Lookup may be enough.
  • You want the expiry of every domain → shopify.com returned an expiry, but two .jp domains we tried in Japan (rakuten.co.jp, xserver.ne.jp) had a blank one (measured in Japan). We have not checked other domains.
  • You want the owner's name or contact → the table does not show them.
  • What "changed date" means → it is the "record changed" date DataForSEO returns, not necessarily the date of a renewal.

This tool does one thing: show one domain's registration date, changed date, expiry date and registrar.

FAQ

Why is the expiry blank in some rows?

No expiry came back. In our tests in Japan, both the .co.jp and .ne.jp domains we tried were blank, while shopify.com had one. We have not confirmed why.

Why is the price high?

It is DataForSEO's pricing: about $0.1212 per call. Think about how many calls you need before you start.

Can I enter a subdomain or www?

"https://", "www." and any path are removed before the lookup. A subdomain (such as blog.example.com) is sent as is, so enter the registered domain (example.com).

How do I get the domain's age?

Count the years from the registration date to today. This tool does not calculate it.

Can I sign up with a free email address?

No. DataForSEO does not accept free email providers. See What is DataForSEO?
